title: Bind Staging Recovery external evidence to a signed acquisition authority without opening unavailable source trust

phases.objective: Replace the static external-acquisition boolean with a branded Ed25519 receipt verifier, implement exact-main independent Network acquisition and bounded OAuth correlation acquisition, keep ChatGPT Registration source authenticity unavailable until a non-forgeable provider source exists, and require the receipt before Kernel execution, countersign, signing, and readiness.

e2e_journeys.actor: Staging Recovery acquisition and certification authority
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Verify a signed exact-SHA acquisition receipt and attempt to progress Staging Recovery certification
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Cryptographically bound receipts can be verified only by branded server/GitHub authorities; Network acquisition is independently runnable, OAuth and Registration source gaps remain typed and fail-closed, and no receipt is issued while either source authority is unavailable.
steps: Build canonical Registration, OAuth, and Network observations with evidence and source-proof hashes.
Sign an acquisition receipt with a dedicated Ed25519 acquisition key and bind exact SHA, target fingerprint, observation IDs, hashes, issuer, key ID, and TTL.
Verify the receipt before any Recovery Kernel state is created and reject a plain caller object as authority.
Reverify the same receipt in GitHub countersign and rerun a fresh same-request Network probe.
Evaluate the source-authority registry before reading the acquisition private key or issuing a receipt.
Keep OAuth foundation-only and Registration unavailable until their server/provider source authorities are actually integrated.
Persist only acquisition public trust in Staging runtime configuration and forbid the private acquisition key from .env.staging.
assertions: No caller field, manual JSON, operator confirmation, or environment flag can convert source authenticity into verified authority.
A forged signature, recomputed-but-different evidence hash, source-proof mismatch, cross-SHA, cross-target, or expired receipt fails closed.
Network direct and Gateway observations bind the same protected route, method, and body hash, with direct trusted-ingress denial and Gateway 2xx.
The acquisition private key is isolated to the staging-recovery-acquisition GitHub Environment and is never reused for Gateway or certification signing.
Registration source attestation unavailable means receipt_issued=false and certification remains blocked.
No Production, provider, or database mutation is authorized by this PR.
